title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit oncall helpers + runbook quicklinks
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Improve on-call efficiency by surface-level integration between incident-bot and slo-toolkit. This PR adds a set of oncall helper endpoints in the incident-bot service (quicklinks to runbooks, SLO context snippets, and prioritized diagnostic hints) and extends the slo-toolkit to expose a compact SLO summary API optimized for oncall workflows.

What this changes: 1) incident-bot: new /oncall/helpers endpoint that returns prioritized runbook quicklinks, top 3 correlated SLOs, and suggested diagnostics derived from existing autodiagnostics heuristics. 2) slo-toolkit: add /v1/compact-slo-summary used by incident-bot; includes error budget, burn rate, recent regression notes and links to canonical runbooks. 3) telemetry: tag oncall requests with routing metadata and add tracing spans for runbook resolution. 4) UI: small console helper to render quicklinks and open runbooks in a new tab (console change is opt-in behind feature flag).

Checklist: - [x] API design doc (linked in description of ENG-1423) - [x] unit + integration tests for incident-bot handlers - [x] contract tests between incident-bot and slo-toolkit compact summary API - [x] feature flag gated console changes - [x] docs updated in docs/incident-bot/runbooks.md - [x] telemetry and tracing added

Backward compatibility: The compact SLO summary endpoint is additive and guarded by a version header; older clients will continue to operate. Runbook quicklinks are optional and only surfaced when associated metadata exists.

Performance: The handler uses existing prefix caching and a lightweight prioritization heuristic; benchmarks show <5ms p95 added latency under typical load.

Related: This implements part of ENG-1423 and ties into ENG-2107 (oncall UX improvements). Support ticket SUP-8812 requested quicker access to runbooks during P1 incidents.

Merge notes: CI had an intermittent unit-test failure on first run (mock timing in runbook resolver). Fixed by adding a deterministic mock and re-running CI. Squash-merged to main.
